findings.location: Definition, the q_e(S) and q_m(S) surface-integral formulas
findings.evidence: The current draft declares only lem-emg-lorentz-hodge-calculus as a dependency, but defines both flux parameters by integrating two-forms over an oriented embedded sphere without defining that integration operation. The published definition def-integral-of-a-compactly-supported-top-form-on-an-oriented-manifold supplies it for a smooth compact oriented sphere. Assigned consumer prop-emg-xs-mp-multicenter uses these flux definitions in proof steps 1.2, 1.3, 2.2, and 3.1; its dependency closure does not include the integration definition.
